title: Designs for Air Force high-altitude reconnaissance competition: MX-2147 and Martin 294
description: Black-and-white photograph of three aircraft models against a dark background, each with a placard reading "MX-2147 Fairchild," "MX-2147 Bell," and "Martin Model 294." Captioned "Designs for the Air Force competition for a high-altitude reconnaissance aircraft." Accompanying text describes Lockheed's submission and Kelly Johnson's early work on the CL-282, later the U-2.
